description: Import geometry edges data to a set with name set_geo by reading point locations from the file with name sfile . Point locations represent ends of the edges, and it is assumed that all imported edges are ordered and connected; thus, a polyline will be created from the imported locations.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Add the group name s using slot slot to all imported edges. Use of the group logic is described in Groups . If not specified the slot name Default is used. More than one group keyword may be given.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: Add the value a to imported edges in extra variable index i . More than one extra keyword may be given.

notes: The engine skips the first line of the file as a header: four lines of points give three nodes and two edges.
One point per line, separated by spaces or commas; two values in a 2D build, three in 3D.
